value.draft: Open label means that no placebo is used in the study. All participants receive the active treatment being tested. Blinding is not applied in this design, meaning both the participants and the researchers know which treatment is being given. This approach is often used when it is not ethical or practical to use a placebo, and it allows for more straightforward observation of the treatment's effects.
